risks: Uncommitted root-owned wave0 bytes are not input_revision proof. Hash-bound observations become stale when root integrates; no Git state was changed or queried.
Current Outline is already canonical list projection. Reintroducing outlineFromHeadings IDs, text-hash IDs or projection index IDs as mutation identity would regress stable anchors.

ListTreeProjection sourceRange is not automatically a whole branch/attached-prose span; retainedRegions contains content absent from visible rows. A tree-only serializer loses prose/code/tables/frontmatter/newlines.
Plain content sourceHash plus independent epoch input does not alone prove an aggregate token changes across authority cutover; accepted LSX-WP-003 interface must prove the required invariant.

Descriptor decoding permits epoch zero (content-descriptor.ts:147); content commit and identity projection require epoch >=1. Do not silently coerce it; reject unsupported/unbound editing state and resolve accepted descriptor lifecycle with lead.
Conservative raw-span rebase cannot resolve arbitrary overlapping structural/text edits. Use explicit stable-ID intent rebase or conflict review; no universal merge promise.
Shared CRDT and native Markdown routing differ. Published specs reject a writable Markdown master beside shared WAL; reuse real router instead of building a second authority in tree-commands.ts.

Host dispatcher, RPC registration, schema exposure and locale files may require paths outside the two allowed shared patches. They must come from accepted dependencies or a revised reviewed packet, not unauthorized worker edits.
A property test or UI stub cannot establish durable native commit, restart, ACL denial or actual Electron appearance; preflight report is never feature-completion evidence.
